name: apprise-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Apprise, a Python notification library: it turns `service://` URLs
into notification plugins, filters them by tags with priorities and retries, converts message
formats, loads URLs from configuration files and sends attachments, and delivers each notification
through the matching plugin.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the Apprise notification core and its webhook plugins: the apprise package modules __init__, apprise, apprise_attachment, apprise_config, asset, common, conversion, exception, logger, manager, manager_attachment, manager_config, manager_plugins, persistent_store, tag and url, the apprise/config, apprise/attachment and apprise/decorators subpackages, the apprise/utils modules base64, cwe312, disk, format, json, logic, module, parse, sanitize, singleton, templates and time, the plugin base apprise/plugins/base.py with apprise/plugins/__init__.py, and the plugins custom_json, custom_xml, custom_form, discord, guilded, mattermost, rocketchat, google_chat, ntfy, gotify, ifttt and ryver under apprise/plugins, together with the documentation in them: their module, class and function docstrings, including the examples in them.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about behavior, the documentation is the authority:
change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit or delete
